rule: Sell a quarter of SOXL if it reaches $108.60 (+20%) before Wednesday's close.
label: Trim a quarter

rule: Sell half of SOXL if it closes below $68 (-25%).
label: Stop: sell half

rule: Sell most of SOXL Thursday if Microsoft or Alphabet cut AI spending plans.
Take profit on SOXL at +40%.
label: Take profit

rule: Bitcoin above $81,000: put C$10,000 of USDC into Bitcoin.
label: Add C$10,000

rule: Bitcoin near $76,000 with the thesis intact: buy the dip with USDC.
label: Buy the dip

rule: Solana below $96 at any update: sell all Solana into Bitcoin.
label: Exit Solana

rule: Bitcoin below $74,000: cut exposure roughly in half.
label: Cut exposure in half

rule: 1 unit = C$1,000; at most 2 units on one bet; no parlays.
If the bankroll falls toward C$80,000, shrink stakes rather than chase losses.
Gold dips to about $3,975 (last week's low) with the thesis intact: add C$10,000 of gold from cash.
label: Add C$10,000 gold

rule: Gold closes above $4,150: add C$10,000 of gold on the breakout.
label: Breakout add

rule: Gold below $3,900: support has broken; sell half the gold.
label: Sell half the gold

rule: Silver below $50: sell all silver into gold or cash.
label: Sell silver

rule: Add ¥66,000 of the cash to the STAR 50 ETF if it falls to ¥1.25 (about 7% below entry).
label: Buy the dip

rule: Sell half the STAR 50 ETF if it falls to ¥1.20 (about 11% below entry): the sell-off is not over.
label: Cut half

rule: Sell a third of the STAR 50 ETF if it rises to ¥1.50 (about 11% above entry).
label: Take some profit

rule: Sell a third of the Semiconductor ETF if it rises to ¥0.90 (about 14% above entry).
label: Take some profit

rule: Sell half the Semiconductor ETF if it falls to ¥0.70 (about 11% below entry).
label: Cut half

rule: If the Fifth Plenum communique (Oct 29) clearly promises more support for growth and the STAR 50 ETF is still below ¥1.40, put the remaining cash into it at the next session.
label: Plenum

rule: Market rules: trade only during Shanghai/Shenzhen hours (9:30–11:30 a.m. and 1:00–3:00 p.m. Beijing; 9:30–11:30 p.m. and 1:00–3:00 a.m. ET until Nov 1, an hour earlier after). Buy in lots of 100 shares. Shares bought today can't be sold until the next trading day.
label: Market rules

rule: Hold the Fed bet to the 2:00 p.m. ET decision on Oct 28; it pays US$1 a share if the Fed holds and nothing if it moves.
label: Fed

rule: Sell half the Senate bet if its price rises to 50¢ before election day (take profit on a polling shift).
label: Take half profit

rule: Sell half the House bet if its price rises to 20¢ before election day.
label: Take half profit

rule: Keep the C$52,000 cash for later markets inside the 30 days (December Fed, October CPI on Nov 10, crypto price markets); only bet where a forecast or data clearly disagrees with the market price.
label: Cash

rule: Settling: a winning share pays US$1 and a losing share pays nothing. Record settlements as a sale at 1.00 or 0.00.
label: Settlement
